description: This file implements an Android activity that reads RSS feeds, downloads and parses RSS data, and displays the items in a list UI. It manages background threading for network operations, custom list adapters for rendering, and handles UI state preservation.

classes.name: RssReader
classes.description: Main activity class that manages RSS feed downloading, parsing, display, and user interactions using a background thread and custom list adapter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, adapters, and event handlers.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, opening the associated RSS item's link in a browser.

methods.name: resetUI
methods.description: Resets the list view and status text to an initial empty state.

methods.name: setCurrentWorker
methods.description: Sets and manages the current background RSS download thread, ensuring only one runs at a time.

methods.name: isCurrentWorker
methods.description: Checks if the given worker thread is the currently active one.

methods.name: doRSS
methods.description: Starts a new background thread to download and parse RSS data from the provided URL.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Removes HTML/XML tags from a string to improve readability.

methods.name: parseRSS
methods.description: Parses RSS data from an InputStream using XmlPullParser, extracting items and posting them to the UI.
